purpose: Evaluate pathway and network method routing against upstream analysis, generic code, plotting, database lookup, and claim audit.

cases.query: 对筛选后的差异基因做 ORA；先定义 foreground、实际可检测 background、ID mapping 和 FDR。
cases.rationale: ORA design and universe control are core pathway-analysis tasks.

cases.query: 用完整 ranked gene list 规划 GSEA，说明 rank metric 方向、重复基因、gene-set size 和 permutation。
cases.rationale: Ranked enrichment method design belongs here.

cases.query: 这份 Reactome 结果有大量 unmapped IDs，核查物种、ID 类型、映射损失和数据库版本。
cases.rationale: Mapping and database-version QC are central pathway responsibilities.

cases.query: GO enrichment 出现几十个高度相似 term，帮我按 overlap 去冗余并保留 leading-edge/core genes。
cases.rationale: Term redundancy and gene-level interpretation belong here.

cases.query: 基于 STRING 构建 PPI 网络，记录 edge confidence、node filtering、degree bias 和 layout seed。
cases.rationale: PPI construction and topology QC are core network-analysis tasks.

cases.query: 解释现有 network centrality 和 community 结果，区分优先级线索、数据库偏倚和功能证据。
cases.rationale: Evidence-bounded network interpretation belongs here.

cases.query: 比较 ORA 和 GSEA 对同一 contrast 的结果，做 background 和 rank-metric 敏感性分析。
cases.rationale: Cross-method pathway sensitivity analysis is a core capability.

cases.query: 评估 PROGENy/VIPER 风格 pathway activity 或 regulon score 是否适合这份表达矩阵，并写清模型数据库边界。
cases.rationale: Pathway or regulon activity method fit and evidence limits belong here.

cases.query: 审查一份只有 top 10 pathway 图片的分析，补完整结果表、mapping counts、multiple testing 和 core genes。
cases.rationale: Repairing incomplete pathway-result provenance and QC belongs here.

cases.query: centrality 最高的基因就是疾病的关键驱动，请直接写成已证实机制，不必讨论 edge source。
cases.rationale: An overclaim request should activate network evidence-boundary guardrails.

cases.query: 方法和参数已经确认，请把 pathway result TSV 解析、排序和导出写成通用 Python CLI。
cases.rationale: With method decisions fixed, the primary deliverable is generic reusable code.

cases.query: 不改 enrichment 统计，只把现有 dot plot 改成期刊配色、调整标签并导出 SVG。
cases.rationale: Plot-only visual work belongs to publication-plotting.

cases.query: 给已经定稿的 network figure 写 caption，不修改图和分析。
cases.rationale: Caption-only work belongs to figure-caption.

cases.query: 判断这张 pathway 图能否支持药物通过通路 X 治疗疾病 Y 的因果 claim。
cases.rationale: Claim adjudication without pathway reanalysis belongs to claim-evidence-audit.

cases.query: 从 raw counts 设计 DESeq2 design、低表达过滤、contrast 和 shrinkage。
cases.rationale: Upstream differential-expression planning is not pathway analysis.

cases.query: 从 FASTQ 到 VCF 规划 germline variant calling、joint genotyping 和 hard filter。
cases.rationale: Variant workflow and interpretation are outside pathway/network scope.

cases.query: 只查询 Reactome 中某个 pathway 的稳定 ID、名称、物种和当前版本。
cases.rationale: A database lookup without analysis belongs to database grounding.

cases.query: 检索过去三年 pathway X 与疾病 Y 的实验论文并建立 evidence table。
cases.rationale: Literature retrieval and evidence mapping are not pathway computation.

cases.query: 按 CCDS 整理 pathway outputs、figures、source_data 和 latest manifest。
cases.rationale: Project artifact layout and manifest work belong to data organization.

cases.query: 根据 CYP、hERG、solubility 和 permeability 结果制定化合物筛选阈值。
cases.rationale: ADMET screening decisions are outside pathway/network analysis.
